anchor_selection: Maximin design-only candidate bank; source-only nested LOCO anchor scores weighted by target weather-descriptor distance; normalized heating/cooling scores combined without target energy labels.
heating_model: paired physics-delta Ridge baseline + HGB residual
total_energy: predicted heating + predicted cooling + source-domain mean non-HVAC intensity
no_post_external_tuning_rule: Do not change model structure, feature set, candidate-pool rule, HGB settings, anchor-selection rule, or reported anchor budgets after viewing external target results.
